adjudication.rationale: In app/controllers/groups_controller.rb#members the diff sets `offset = params[:offset].to_i` and then unconditionally applies it via `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)`. There is no clamping/validation to prevent negative values (unlike the JS side which clamps), so a request with `offset=-1` will pass a negative OFFSET to PostgreSQL, which raises an error (“OFFSET must not be negative”), resulting in a 500. This is a concrete correctness issue present in the changed code path.
